# Brand Vision Media

> Premier Airport & Outdoor Advertising Network in Hyderabad & South India.

## Overview
Brand Vision Media is an out-of-home (OOH) and digital out-of-home (DOOH) advertising media firm headquartered in Secunderabad, Telangana, with operations across Hyderabad, Bangalore, and South India. The company manages a network of over 100 high-impact billboard locations and exclusive digital airport assets across Hyderabad and South India.

## Key Media Inventory & Flagship Assets

### 1. Rajiv Gandhi International Airport (RGIA Shamshabad)
- **Monthly Passenger Reach**: 2,800,000+ verified air travelers.
- **T1 Concourse 4K Curved LED**: Overhead digital display spanning the primary departure walkway to Gates 1–22. 100% of departing flyers pass beneath this display. Calibrated at 1200+ nits.
- **Arrivals Baggage Carousel Video Walls**: Synchronized digital video walls stationed directly at eye level above carousels 1 to 6. Average passenger dwell time of 28 minutes.
- **Boarding Gates 101–112 Digital Totems**: High-density 85-inch portrait totems stationed in departure hold lounges capturing CXOs, tech founders, and business travelers with 35–45 minutes of captive wait time.

### 2. Large-Format Highway & Arterial Billboards
- **The Trilight Kokapet Mega Hoarding**: 120 ft width x 35 ft height (4,200 sq.ft canvas). Over 500 meters of unobstructed straight-line visibility along the arterial corridor connecting the Financial District, Neopolis, and Kokapet (140,000+ daily vehicles).
- **Airport Approach Sequential Unipoles**: A series of four consecutive large-format hoardings (60 ft x 30 ft each) along the primary RGIA approach highway (110,000+ daily vehicles), enabling sequential brand storytelling.
- **Narsingi Elevated Unipoles**: Overlooking the Gachibowli-Outer Ring Road (ORR) flyover interchange at 45ft elevation with 400m clear visibility during peak transit crawls.
- **Gandipet & IT Corridor Backlit Median Kiosks**: 12 dual-sided illuminated totems reaching 85,000 daily IT commuters along Nanakramguda and Gandipet.

## Technical & Production Standards
- **Substrate Specification**: Heavy-duty frontlit flex vinyl (minimum 340 to 450 GSM tensile strength).
- **Ink Technology**: Solvent and UV-stabilized industrial inks calibrated for high Deccan heat and prolonged exterior exposure.
- **Illumination**: Commercial dusk-to-dawn calibrated LED floodlights operating on automated astronomical lux timers (150–200 lux uniform surface illumination).
- **Proof of Performance (PoP)**: Comprehensive digital audit dossier with date, time, and GPS-tagged day and night inspection photographs delivered within 24 hours of going live.

## Geographic Coverage
- **Primary Market**: Hyderabad, Cyberabad, Secunderabad, Rajiv Gandhi International Airport (Shamshabad), Kokapet (The Golden Mile), Financial District (Gachibowli), Narsingi, Gandipet.
- **Regional Coverage**: Unified campaign execution across Bangalore and major South Indian metropolitan corridors.
